reference.title: Svo Subordinate Manager view
reference.shortdesc: This manager lists related BACnet export descriptors and references to subordinate structured view objects. It functions in a remote controller station, not in a Supervisor station.

fig.title: Svo Subordinate Manager view on the BacnetExportFolder

section.p: To access this view, log in to the remote controller station, expand ConfigDriversBacnetNetwork right-click ExportFolder and click ViewsSvo Subordinate Manager
In the exposed structured view object (from a BACnet export folder), subordinates appear in two property lists:

li.p: Subordinate_List: List of object identifiers for all BACnet objects the SVO organizes.
Subordinate_Annotations: List of descriptions of the same objects—the same size as the Subordinate_List, where entries in one correspond to entries in the other.

section.p: Most entries are automatic subordinates, shown on the right side. These result from either child BACnet server descriptors or export folders.
The buttons below the left side of the view allow you to Edit or Delete manually-added entries for subordinate objects.
section.note: The same BACnet object can be a subordinate in more than one Structured View Object. For example, an Analog Input object that represents a temperature can be a subordinate in both a Temperatures SVO tree as well as a Admin Building SVO tree.

li.p: Edit opens an existing entry for editing.
